notes: Blender reimport of the exported FBX. Not a Unity Game view.
Unity was not available headless, so no Game-view capture.

NewCharsPreview instances SERAPHINE_rig_rest.fbx and only samples bone curves. rig_rest is byte-identical to main, so the curled grip (a bind-mesh edit on the clip FBXs) does not appear in that scene.
The throw spear is an unparented rigid mesh in SERAPHINE_attack_throw.fbx so it can leave the hand. The preview's skinned spear stays on the right hand.

Walk bone heads match the shipped walk to 3.7e-6 m. Skeleton heads/tails match rig_rest to 8.2e-7 m. The historical digest d5611ac70629687b was not reproduced by the hash function used here; the positional match is the check.
Cape in the plates is rigidly carried on Spine2, not Unity's spring. Triangle tests against that posed cape are 0.
Right-hand fingers have no bones. The curl is a bind-mesh rotation of RightHand-weighted vertices, max 12.4 cm. Weights are unchanged.
